---
title: "Egg clean up"
author: "Eva Kerr"
date: "2025-09-16"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
# ---- Clean Jones egg-mass data -> Rana capito detection (minimal columns) ----
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)

egg_raw <- readr::read_csv("combined_egg_mass_data_2023_2024.csv",
                           guess_max = 5000, show_col_types = FALSE)

# 1) Normalize header names (lowercase, trim, collapse spaces)
nm <- names(egg_raw)
nm <- str_replace_all(nm, "\\s+", " ")
nm <- str_trim(nm)
nm <- str_to_lower(nm)
names(egg_raw) <- nm

# 2) Rename species/count columns to species_1..5 and count_1..5
egg <- egg_raw %>%
  rename_with(~ str_replace(., "^species (\\d+)$", "species_\\1")) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_replace(., "^species (\\d+) number of egg masses$", "count_\\1"))

# 3) Parse date robustly (try 'date', else pull date part from 'date and time')
#    Handles ymd / mdy in 'date'; and ymd_hms / mdy_hms in 'date and time'
date_from_date <- suppressWarnings(ymd(egg$date))
date_from_date <- ifelse(is.na(date_from_date),
                         as.character(suppressWarnings(mdy(egg$date))),
                         as.character(date_from_date))
date_from_date <- as.Date(date_from_date)

dt_col <- egg[["date and time"]]
date_from_dt <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(ymd_hms(dt_col)))
if (all(is.na(date_from_dt))) {
  date_from_dt <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(mdy_hms(dt_col)))
}

egg <- egg %>%
  mutate(
    date = coalesce(date_from_date, date_from_dt),
    year = coalesce(as.integer(year), as.integer(format(date, "%Y"))),
    wetlandid = str_remove(as.character(`wetland number`), "^\\s*[Ww]\\s*"),
    site = "Jones Center Ichauway"
  )

# 4) Clean species/count fields
egg2 <- egg %>%
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("species_"), ~ na_if(str_squish(.), "")),
    across(starts_with("count_"), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.)))
  )

# 5) Long -> detect Rana capito (sum counts across slots), then 0/1 Detected
capito_regex <- "(?i)\\b(rana\\s*capito|r\\.?\\s*capito)\\b"

egg_long <- egg2 %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^(species|count)_\\d+$"),
    names_to  = c(".value","slot"),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    species = str_squish(species),
    is_capito = !is.na(species) & str_detect(species, capito_regex),
    count = coalesce(as.numeric(count), 0)
  ) %>%
  filter(is_capito) %>%
  group_by(row_id) %>%
  summarise(EggMassCount = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

egg_clean <- egg2 %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(egg_long, by = "row_id") %>%
  mutate(
    EggMassCount = coalesce(EggMassCount, 0),
    Detected = as.integer(EggMassCount > 0),
    month = factor(format(date, "%B"), levels = month.name)
  ) %>%
  select(site, wetlandid, date, year, month, Detected)

# Quick check
print(summary(egg_clean$date))
print(table(egg_clean$Detected, useNA = "ifany"))

# Save only the needed columns
readr::write_csv(egg_clean, "egg_mass_clean_capito.csv")

```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

egg_clean <- readr::read_csv("egg_mass_clean_capito.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# 1) Exact list of detections (unique date–wetland pairs)
det_list <- egg_clean %>%
  filter(Detected == 1) %>%
  distinct(date, wetlandid, site) %>%
  arrange(date, wetlandid)

print(det_list, n = Inf)   # show all rows



# 2) Quick per-wetland summary (how many days, first/last detection)
det_summary <- det_list %>%
  group_by(wetlandid) %>%
  summarise(
    n_days = n_distinct(date),
    first_detection = min(date),
    last_detection  = max(date),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(wetlandid)

print(det_summary, n = Inf)


```
